title: Duality for Garding operators and a new inequality of GM/AM type
summary: This article concerns Garding Dirichlet operators, and also the theory of Garding polynomials. Garding Dirichlet operators are those which arise from homogeneous polynomials on the space S(n) of symmetric $n \times n$ polynomials, which are hyperbolic with respect to any positive definite matrix. (In particular, any polynomial on ${\mathbb R}^n$, which is hyperbolic with respect to elements in $({\mathbb R_+})^n$, gives rise to a Garding operator on S(n), in many ways.)
